buses.line: On all those double decker buses
stanza: They all laugh at angry young men
They all laughed at Edison and also at Einstein
So why should I feel sorry if they just couldn't understand
The idiomatic logic that went on in my head?
I had a brain, it was insane
Oh, they used to laugh at me when I refused to ride
On all those double decker buses
All because there was no driver on the top

buses.line: 2000 out the weekly under "Cycles to Gehenna" gets him floating over 20 buses
